context: Implemented the full TRIAGE-SPEC §10 test suite (items 1-13) in test/triage-engine.test.ts: 27 tests parameterized over both file and sqlite backends (54 runs) via per-backend fixtures with controlled ids/timestamps and injected clocks. No implementation deviations found — src/engine/triage.ts passed every spec-mandated assertion unchanged. Full npm test (1355 passed, 2 pre-existing skips) and npm run build clean.
rationale: Used a far-future injected clock (2030) for the §10.12 exact age_ms assertion so a Date.now()-hardcoding implementation fails by years, not milliseconds
